analysis.finding: The KML is a multi-segment geometry collection. Its total geometric length matches the previously observed 216.099 km value, but the segments are not guaranteed to form one ordered production route simply by concatenation.

normalization_policy: Preserve the original KML as source evidence.
Do not declare this source as current official production geometry solely from its filename.
Build an ordered route only after deterministic segment ordering and continuity checks.
Validate start/end against the official route definition.
Keep geometric length separate from the official published distance.
Do not alter official stage distances to force agreement with measured geometry.
Do not silently bridge large spatial gaps between segments.
next_validation: Identify disconnected/auxiliary segments and quantify them.
Validate ordered geometry start and end against Gaia and Fatima.
Run RouteLocationEngine tests against the normalized geometry.
Only then promote a derived geometry asset for the walking map.
